item.title: Spartacus by Armaf – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Spartacus by Armaf is a bold aromatic-woody-vanilla scent for men, most often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu — the same warm, edible vanilla-and-praline character, with Parfums de Marly Althaïr in the same conversation.

It opens bright and spicy on bergamot, cardamom and cinnamon with a juicy plum and orange blossom lift, then turns soft and edible through lavender, davana, elemi, bourbon vanilla and candied almond. The base settles in for the long haul: praline, tonka bean, benzoin, amber, patchouli, labdanum and guaiac wood over clean musk. Sweet but not syrupy, and best in cool weather or at night.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Plum
Middle: Lavender, Davana, Elemi, Bourbon Vanilla, Candied Almond
Base: Praline, Musk, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Amber, Patchouli, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

item.title: Onyx Silver by Khadlaj – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Onyx Silver by Khadlaj is a fresh-spicy woody masculine. Bergamot, ginger and black pepper give it a sharp, peppery opening.

Petitgrain and cardamom keep the heart green and aromatic, and it settles into a warm sweet-woody base of patchouli, labdanum, benzoin and tonka bean. Crisp up top, rich underneath — an easy year-round pick.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Ginger, Black Pepper
Middle: Petitgrain, Cardamom
Base: Patchouli, Labdanum, Benzoin, Tonka Bean

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

item.title: Bravanzo Imperial by Dumont – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Electimus Imperium
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.75 - 24.80 (5 variants)

Overview

Bravanzo Imperial by Dumont (Ramon Blazar) is a citrus-woody Extrait most often compared to Electimus Imperium, with a nod to the bright, resinous side of Mancera Cedrat Boisée.

Grapefruit, bergamot and pink pepper open it sharp and spicy, oakmoss, incense and cashmere wood build the heart, and it dries down on amber, patchouli, ambergris and white musk. Loud, polished and long-lasting.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Oakmoss, Incense, Cashmere Wood
Base: Amber, Patchouli, Ambergris, White Musk

Concentration: Extrait de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

Overview

Marasi For Her by Arabiyat Prestige is a sweet floral-fruity gourmand. Hazelnut, raspberry, mango and bergamot open it up.

A playful heart of cotton candy, violet, orange blossom and patchouli follows, and it lands on vanilla, tonka bean, caramel and musk. Dessert-sweet and cosy — a strong cold-weather and date-night pick.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Hazelnut, Raspberry, Mango, Bergamot
Middle: Patchouli, Cotton Candy, Violet, Orange Blossom
Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk, Caramel

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Feminine

Type: Fragrance Decant

Overview

Asteria by Velixir is a bright floral-woody musk often compared to Louis Vuitton City of Stars. It opens on a burst of blood orange, mandarin, bergamot and lemon.

Creamy tiare flower softens the heart, and it settles on sandalwood, musk and powdery notes. Clean, sunny and effortless, with a soft skin-scent drydown.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blood Orange, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Tiare Flower
Base: Sandalwood, Musk, Powdery Notes

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

Type: Fragrance Decant

Overview

Throne Eclipse by Maison Asrar is the darker, after-dark chapter of the Throne line, and its apple-and-spice opening over a creamy vanilla base puts it in the same family as Parfums de Marly Layton.

Crisp apple meets clove and cardamom up top, cinnamon, geranium and lavender warm the heart, and it finishes on vanilla, amber and cedarwood. Rich, sweet-spicy and built for cold weather.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Apple, Clove, Cardamom
Middle: Cinnamon, Geranium, Lavender
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Cedarwood

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

Amalfi Bianco Pour Homme by Jo Milano is a smoky-fresh masculine inspired by the Amalfi Coast. Bright bergamot opens it, an aromatic heart of lavender and a warm fire accord gives it depth.

It finishes on woody notes and soft smoke — a refined, memorable trail that works best in cooler weather and after dark.

Virtus by Riiffs is an Extrait de Parfum often compared to Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF L'Absolu — a clean, modern masculine built on warm cardamom, bright bergamot and zesty ginger.

Type:

Salvo Intense by Maison Alhambra

Salvo Intense is the deeper, warmer take on Maison Alhambra's Salvo, and is widely compared to Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum. Juicy bergamot leads into a peppery, aromatic heart of Sichuan pepper, lavender and star anise with a warm touch of cinnamon, resting on a smooth ambery base of ambergris and vanilla.

Fresh, spicy and magnetic – an easy everyday signature with plenty of presence.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot
Middle: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Star Anise, Cinnamon
Base: Ambergris, Vanilla

item.title: Emperor by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspired by Creed Absolu Aventus
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Emperor by Bujairami

Emperor is Bujairami's tribute to Creed Absolu Aventus. Crisp grapefruit, apple, bergamot and blackcurrant open fresh and fruity, before a warm spiced heart of ginger, cinnamon and cardamom softened with jasmine and lily of the valley. The drydown is smooth and confident – ambergris, patchouli, vetiver and cashmere woods with a touch of pink pepper.

A polished fruity-woody signature for the office, evenings out and everything in between.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Apple, Bergamot, Blackcurrant
Middle: Ginger, Cinnamon, Lily of the Valley, Citron, Jasmine, Cardamom
Base: Ambergris, Pink Pepper, Cashmere, Patchouli, Vetiver

Red Static by Bujairami

Red Static is Bujairami's take on Dior Rouge Trafalgar Esprit de Parfum – a juicy, glossy red-fruit fragrance. Dark cherry and a flicker of pink pepper open bright and playful, then a lush double rose heart of Bulgarian and Turkish rose settles over a sweet base of red berries.

Vivid, fruity and romantic, it wears easily on anyone and works day to night.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cherry, Pink Pepper
Middle: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose
Base: Red Fruits

Overview

Pacific Aura by Rayhaan is inspired by Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill — a cool, sparkling fresh scent that opens with citron, mandarin, bergamot and crisp mint over a tangy touch of black currant and coriander.

A green heart of basil, soft rose and carrot seed follows, drying down to fig, amber and ambroxan. Ocean breeze and clear blue sky — a strong warm-weather and everyday pick.

Top: Citron, Mandarin, Mint, Bergamot, Black Currant, Coriander
Middle: Basil, Rose, Carrot Seed
Base: Amber, Fig, Ambroxan

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

Type: Fragrance Decant

Overview

Conquer by Mykonos is an Extrait de Parfum inspired by Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF L'Absolu — a confident spicy-woody scent that opens with a surge of bergamot sharpened by ginger and cardamom.

It builds through a smooth heart of orris and orange blossom, then settles into a warm, grounded base of patchouli, modern amber, musk and vanilla. Controlled power rather than loudness, easy to wear day or night.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Ginger, Cardamom
Middle: Orris, Orange Blossom
Base: Patchouli, Modern Amber, Musk, Vanilla

Concentration: Extrait de Parfum · Gender: Masculine (wears unisex)
